propositions: Commit subjects exceeding 50 characters are rejected locally with specific line and length output.

Commit body lines exceeding 72 characters are rejected locally, with carve-outs for trailers, TAG= lines, fenced code blocks, 4+ space indentation, table rows, and atomic tokens (URLs/paths/dotted identifiers).
The commit-message-wrap hook runs at the commit-msg stage via pre-commit without clobbering Gerrit's Change-Id hook (preserved as commit-msg.legacy in migration mode).
The make hooks target verifies both pre-commit and commit-msg hook files exist and warns if Gerrit's Change-Id stamping is not found in the hook chain.
CONTRIBUTING.md documents the 50/72 enforcement, exemption rules, commit-msg-stage rationale, and warns against running pre-commit install -f.
